technical_debt: Data-health guardrail inspects only unstaged tracked names and hard-codes a green no-mutation claim.
user_impact: A user can receive false assurance that protected systems are untouched.
engineering_impact: Staged or untracked protected changes and Git diagnostic failures are not represented truthfully.
lane_disposition: Focused later lane: fail closed, inspect staged/untracked state, derive status from explicit protected families, and add deterministic tests.

technical_debt: Refresh latest-status and source-manifest writes are not atomic; corrupt latest status has no archive fallback.
user_impact: A crash can erase the latest trustworthy receipt or make the UI appear to have no status.
engineering_impact: Partial writes and silent None returns make recovery and incident review fragile.
lane_disposition: Pair with TD-001 in one bounded data-health reliability lane.

technical_debt: Two Rankings trust tests assert literal implementation text in a thin wrapper.
user_impact: No production defect was established; failures reduce confidence in the baseline signal.
engineering_impact: Tests break when trusted content moves behind a component/service boundary.
current_evidence: app/pages/05_rankings.py;tests;documented focused run: 2 failed and 3 passed
lane_disposition: Park until the intended behavior boundary is agreed; do not weaken the trust contract merely to turn tests green.

technical_debt: Expanded draft test slices assume ignored local pack/history artifacts.
user_impact: Contributors can see failures or skips in a clean checkout that do not reflect a production regression.
engineering_impact: Non-hermetic tests slow review and make failures environment-dependent.
current_evidence: src/config/constants.py;tests;documented expanded run: 3 failed and 6 skipped when local artifacts were absent
lane_disposition: Separate hermetic-fixture lane after higher-value guardrail work.
